_comment: SPEC-BLOCO-03 pieces 2 and 3 at commit 183a2b4 (instant-win-audit/v2, feat/keptra-escrow-pool), compiled with forge 1.5.1 under that commit’s foundry.toml: solc 0.8.21, evm paris, via_ir, 200 runs. Creation code only; the fork suite deploys it. KeptraEscrow deploys KeptraReputation and KeptraGuarantee deploys KeptraVoucher. The escrow’s hash is the one piece 4 pins (OracleReceiver.fork.t.sol ESCROW_CREATION_CODE_HASH). Hashes are written without the 0x prefix: the repository refuses any 32-byte hex literal, the shape of a private key (F2).
